about: Topic starter boards for Talk Boards. Drafted with AI, pictures chosen by hand from library/index.json, and reviewed by a teacher with review.html. Only "approved" topics have been checked by a teacher.

core.notes: These 15 squares match the classroom core-word board. Please check the picture for "you" (OpenMoji "index pointing at the viewer"): a reviewer said it can read as a fist. It is on every topic board, so if it should change, it changes everywhere at once.

topics.name: Fire drill
topics.blurb: The alarm, lining up and going outside.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for alarm: Siren light (OpenMoji): there is no fire-alarm picture in either set. Picture for cover ears: Hear-no-evil monkey covering its ears (OpenMoji). Picture for friend: Handshake (OpenMoji): the people-holding-hands picture looked too like "he, she, it".

topics.name: First day of school
topics.blurb: Meeting the teacher and finding your way.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for friend: Handshake (OpenMoji): the people-holding-hands picture looked too like "he, she, it".

topics.name: Lunch
topics.blurb: Eating, drinking and asking for help to open things.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left).

topics.name: Recess
topics.blurb: The playground, turns and getting hurt.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). "Sandbox" is called a sandpit in the UK. Picture for friend: Handshake (OpenMoji): the people-holding-hands picture looked too like "he, she, it". Picture for my turn: Index finger pointing up: neither set has a "my turn" symbol. Picture for your turn: Hand pointing to the side: neither set has a "your turn" symbol.

topics.name: Bathroom
topics.blurb: Toilet, washing hands and asking for help.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Swap "pee" and "poop" for the words the school and family use. Picture for pee: Mulberry "need toilet". Picture for accident: Mulberry "wet" (second version): two water drops.

topics.name: Getting dressed for outside
topics.blurb: Coats, hats and the weather.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Depends on the season: swap the weather squares as needed.

topics.name: Art
topics.blurb: Drawing, painting, cutting and gluing.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left).

topics.name: Music
topics.blurb: Singing, dancing and instruments.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left).

topics.name: Library
topics.blurb: Choosing and reading books.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for this one: Hand pointing down, for "I choose this one".

topics.name: Bus or car ride
topics.blurb: Seats, seat belts and how long it takes.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for driver: Mulberry "taxi driver", used for any driver.

topics.name: Doctor or nurse
topics.blurb: Saying what hurts and what helps.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for tummy: Mulberry "stomach ache", which shows the tummy hurting. Picture for cough: Face with a medical mask: neither set has a cough picture.

topics.name: Haircut
topics.blurb: The chair, scissors, clippers and how it feels.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for clippers: OpenMoji razor: neither set has hair clippers.

topics.name: Birthday party
topics.blurb: Cake, presents, balloons and saying thank you.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for friend: Handshake (OpenMoji): the people-holding-hands picture looked too like "he, she, it". Picture for game: A die (OpenMoji) stands for games in general.

topics.name: Substitute teacher
topics.blurb: A different teacher for the day.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for schedule: Clipboard (OpenMoji): neither set has a visual schedule picture. Picture for different: Mulberry "change": neither set has "different".

topics.name: Assembly and loud noises
topics.blurb: Sitting with everyone, and what to do when it is loud.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for cover ears: Hear-no-evil monkey covering its ears (OpenMoji).

topics.name: Waiting my turn
topics.blurb: Turns, lines and timers.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for my turn: Index finger pointing up: neither set has a "my turn" symbol. Picture for your turn: Hand pointing to the side: neither set has a "your turn" symbol. Picture for later: OpenMoji "SOON" arrow, which has English text on it.

topics.name: Calm-down choices
topics.blurb: The Calming Corner tools, to choose a way to calm down.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Every square is a Calming Corner tool and already has a clip in the app voice. Picture for glitter jar: Mulberry "glitter": check that it reads as the Calming Corner glitter jar.

topics.name: Morning routine
topics.blurb: Arriving, unpacking and starting the day.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for schedule: Clipboard (OpenMoji): neither set has a visual schedule picture.

topics.name: Home time
topics.blurb: Packing up and going home.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Swap "mom", "dad" and "grandma" for the child's own family. Mulberry's picture is named "mum".

topics.name: Sensory needs
topics.blurb: Too loud, too bright, and what helps.
topics.notes: Core words are in the same squares as on the core-word board (top left). Picture for lights off: Mulberry "turn down light". Picture for fidget toy: OpenMoji yo-yo: neither set has a fidget spinner or squishy toy.
